name: Alderman Dozey
text: Larder items played on this: +2/+2 per gold. Every 3 turns in this slot: double its stats.
golden_text: Larder items played on this: +4/+4 per gold. Every 3 turns in this slot: double its stats.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Feeding rounds up. Wakes after all other End of Turn effects; includes standing tribe bonuses, excludes auras and fight buffs. Moving or tripling restarts the wait. Extra triggers do not advance or repeat a wake.
